mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of FEDFUNDS decline instances (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2% in next month
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite FEDFUNDS > 2% trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (inflation) rises while FEDFUNDS remain below 2%, market uncertainty intensifies, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to divergent policy signals.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases while FEDFUNDS remains below 2% in next month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL ↑ and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in UNRATE below 5% signals strengthening labor demand, boosting wage growth and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >60% of UNRATE <5% instances (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (demand) outpaces INDPRO (supply) growth, indicating rising demand pressures, this triggers inflationary expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases in next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 ↑ and INDPRO ↓ do not correlate with positive 20d returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 4% signals tight labor markets, spurring wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4% in next month
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE >4% trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (industrial production) indicates strengthening demand, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive when HOUST ↑ over next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months signals sustained monetary easing, lowering long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS <1% 3-month periods (p > 0.05).
